correctness.rationale: For all n>=3 every profile is a balanced two-transition count, an endpoint-imbalanced count, or constant. The exact positive-run compositions give both fiber formulas. Discrete log concavity centralizes the loops; comparing trail and balanced profiles excludes imbalanced maximizers; a monotone consecutive-binomial quotient identifies the unique or tied maximizing mode at every n. Small ranks n=1,2 are checked separately. Stirling yields the exact 2/pi coefficient. A standalone independent finite checker confirms the formulas and all n>=7 optimizer profiles over its exhaustive range. The finite experiments are not used as an infinite proof.
